definition_of_software_complete: current research and governance state can be inspected from one operator flow
paper-readiness state has one deterministic non-authorizing release verdict
risk and drawdown controls fail closed
operator-facing public and founder interfaces have a coherent executive information hierarchy
deployment health and revision provenance are independently checkable
routine dependency maintenance does not create avoidable CI failures
fixed_rules: production stays on the last green main while branch work is tested
CI, CodeQL, or live-boundary security failures block merge
UI and delivery work cannot expand research, exchange, order, credential, paper/live trading, Mission 104, or capital authority
exchange adapters, broker integrations, credentials, paper/live execution, and capital activation remain out of scope unless the founder explicitly changes authority in a future decision
a failed research hypothesis is recorded; the roadmap does not create rescue tuning
new architecture must remove a release blocker or replace a weaker existing mechanism
temporary founder unavailability never idles unrelated safe work; park manual blockers and continue independent lanes

lanes.exit_condition: one fail-closed verdict covers paper sandbox, institutional risk, capital-readiness-for-paper, and drawdown kill-switch state without granting authority
lanes.next: surface the existing verdict through a read-only operator flow without running paper/live components or adding authority

lanes.exit_condition: public observer reads like a quantitative research control surface rather than a marketing landing page; durable research-state markers remain visible
options: dense executive console with tables and status tape
terminal-style workspace only if density cannot remain readable
split public review site and founder cockpit if one information architecture becomes too compromised
lanes.selection_rule: prefer the least decorative option that makes status, risk, evidence, and next decision legible in under 30 seconds

lanes.exit_condition: founder research workspace uses restrained executive hierarchy, dense tabular review, semantic state colour, accessible focus, and reduced decorative chrome without changing research APIs or authority
options: presentation-only override over proven React behavior
targeted component restructuring if hierarchy cannot be fixed in presentation alone
full information-architecture rewrite only if the existing view model prevents fast review
lanes.selection_rule: start with the reversible presentation-only option; escalate only when a specific operator task remains materially harder

lanes.exit_condition: one supported command or founder action can inspect prerequisites and return the non-authorizing operational readiness verdict with durable evidence without starting paper/live components
lanes.next: feed the supported readiness verdict into operator release-candidate verification without adding execution authority
lanes.selection_rule: reuse verified state and verdicts; do not invoke or rewrite paper/live execution engines under current authority

lanes.exit_condition: scheduled or manual production parity can bind the live observer to an exact main revision without interfering with PR boundary checks
lanes.blocker: GitHub public-production lacks usable CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID; the public site remains reachable but the exact deployed SHA is unverified
lanes.parallel_work_rule: continue operator-release-candidate and product-quality work while external configuration is pending
options: existing production-parity workflow with stronger surfaced revision evidence
immutable deployment marker emitted by the worker build
both, if the marker remains independently verifiable
lanes.selection_rule: prefer independent evidence over application self-reporting

lanes.exit_condition: fresh-clone/operator verification, non-authorizing readiness gate, documentation, backup/recovery, and public/founder boundary checks pass together
lanes.current_focus: assemble one machine-backed release verdict from fresh-clone checks, read-only operational readiness, documentation/continuity, backup/recovery evidence, and the live public/private boundary; keep deployment provenance as an explicit blocker until external credentials are configured
options: single release checklist backed by machine checks
signed release manifest if provenance needs a stronger artifact
lanes.selection_rule: a human-readable release verdict must be derivable from machine evidence

lanes.exit_condition: DeltaGrid is usable for authorized research, backtesting, forward/shadow observation, deterministic readiness inspection, and durable evidence review without unfinished operator-critical paths
lanes.selection_rule: ship the smallest complete operating system inside current authority; defer non-blocking features

replan_triggers.trigger: a lane misses its target by more than 48 hours
replan_triggers.action: drop or defer non-blocking work and choose the shortest safe option listed for that lane

replan_triggers.trigger: a new security or authority flaw is verified
replan_triggers.action: promote remediation above UI and feature work

replan_triggers.trigger: an existing verified subsystem already solves the planned work
replan_triggers.action: integrate it instead of building a duplicate

replan_triggers.trigger: a proposed feature cannot name a release blocker it removes
replan_triggers.action: defer it until after software v1

replan_triggers.trigger: presentation-only UI changes cannot make an operator task legible without hiding or duplicating evidence
replan_triggers.action: escalate that view to targeted component restructuring while preserving the same data and authority contracts
